lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I wanted ta see how it felt.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: During this whole thing, did you ever think about trying to stop Steven?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I thought he would try ta like, try ta kill me.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Mark just asked you a little while ago, if he ever threatened you. Now earlier you had said, Monday, you talked about something like that and now you said no. What's the truth?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He didn't threaten me, I just thought that he was, he coulda, cuz he's bigger than me, that he could probably beat me up and that.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So you telling us now that he never threatened you?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And you admit you knew this that you had told us that Monday?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: But now you sayin' that didn't happen? (Brendan nods “yes”) Did Steve say anything else to you, offer you anything for doing this or keeping your mouth shut (Brendan shakes head “no”) or anything like that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he tell you anything about sayin' anything about this to anyone? (Brendan shakes head “no”) He just let you go into the, the bed that night and didn't say anything to you like about this?

lines.speaker: FAASSBENDER
lines.text: Did you ever think about callin' the police?
